text: DEFONEOS — DWP Universal Credit Managed Migration AI Deep-Dive Pack EU AI Act Article 50 live 2 Aug 2026 — C2PA passport ready | Get yours → Home Master GovBench Index Sitemap DEFONEOS × DWP × UC MANAGED MIGRATION DWP Universal Credit Managed Migration AI Deep-Dive Pack Sovereign AI governance of UK DWP Universal Credit managed migration — legacy benefit transition, ESA migration, income support wind-down, tax credit closure, housing benefit transfer, pension credit protection, vulnerable claimant safeguards. 12 entry points × 8 transformation priorities × 6 MCPs. Audit-grade. Signed. UK-sovereign. 12 Entry Points 8 Transformation Priorities 6 MCP Servers 6 Red Lines 📋 12 Entry Points Migration Managed Migration — DWP Notice, Deadline, Transitional Protection UC managed migration process — DWP issues Migration Notice to legacy claimants. 3-month deadline to claim UC or lose legacy benefits. Transitional protection payments — cash and element protection. Migration Notice sequencing — geographic rollout, caseload priority. Voluntary migration vs managed migration. Natural migration via change of circumstances. Deadlines extension for vulnerable claimants. Statutory instrument framework — UC (Transitional Provisions) regulations. ESA ESA Migration — Work Capability, Support Group Transition Employment and Support Allowance migration to UC — contribution-based ESA ends, income-based ESA transitions. Work Capability Assessment migration — existing LCWRA/LCW determinations honoured. Support Group to UC LCWRA mapping. Assessment period alignment. Severe Disability Premium loss — transitional protection. Carer premium migration. ESA youth to UC transition. WRAG group to UC work-related requirements. 12-month reassessment scheduling. Tax Credits Tax Credit Closure — WTC/CTC to UC, HMRC Final Awards Working Tax Credit and Child Tax Credit closure — HMRC to DWP transfer. Final award calculations — annual income assessment to monthly. Self-employed minimum income floor interaction. WTC disability element to UC LCWRA mapping. Childcare element — 85% vs previous 70% support. Tax credit overpayment debt migration. HMRC reconciliation timing. Pension credit interaction. WTC hours rules replaced by UC work conditionality. Housing Housing Benefit Transfer — LHA, Social Tenant, Supported Housing Housing Benefit migration to UC — local authority to DWP transfer. Local Housing Allowance rates — direct payment to landlord default. Social housing — bedroom tax equivalent under UC. Supported housing — exempt accommodation carve-out. Rent verification process. Alternative Payment Arrangements — managed payments to landlords. Housing cost contributions — non-dependant deductions. Service charges treatment. Temporary accommodation interaction. Pension Pension Credit Protection — Guarantee Credit, Savings Credit Pension Credit interaction with UC migration — pensioners not required to claim UC. Guarantee Credit preserved for mixed-age couples. Savings Credit abolition for new claims. Severe Disability Premium protection — SDP transitional element. Mixed-age couple rule — youngest partner age determines benefit. State Pension uprating interaction. Pension age housing costs — HB vs UC. Carer addition preservation. Minimum income guarantee transition. Vulnerable Vulnerable Claimant Safeguards — Domestic Abuse, Mental Health, Digital Exclusion Vulnerable claimant protections during migration — domestic abuse survivors (UR refuges), mental health crisis, homelessness, learning disabilities, addiction. Digital exclusion — telephone claims, face-to-face support, Assisted Digital service. Reasonable adjustments — large print, BSL, translation. Third-party appointee system. Frequent Payment Alternative — fortnightly UC payments. Managed migration extension requests. Universal Support programme — Citizens Advice, local authorities. Income Income Support Wind-Down — Carer, Disability, Lone Parent Transition Income Support closure — carer premium migration to UC car
